records.jp: いいところに来たわね
records.en_original: You came at the perfect time.
records.en_auxiliary: You came at the perfect time.
records.en: Perfect timing.

records.jp: 何か用事だった？
records.en_original: Did you need something?
records.en_auxiliary: Did you need something?
records.en: Did you need me?

records.jp: また生徒会から呼び出しがあったのよ
records.en_original: The student council called for us again.
records.en_auxiliary: The student council called for us again.
records.en: The student council summoned us again.

records.jp: えっ？　何の用だろ
records.en_original: Huh? What could they want?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? What could they want?
records.en: Huh? What could they want?

records.jp: さあ？　行けばわかるでしょ？
records.en_original: Who knows? We'll find out when we go.
records.en_auxiliary: Who knows? We'll find out when we go.
records.en: Who knows? We'll find out when we go.

records.jp: それで、何の御用でしょうか？
records.en_original: I believe you had some business with us?
records.en_auxiliary: I believe you had some business with us?
records.en: What did you need us for?

records.jp: その……あなたたち二人に謝らなきゃいけないと思って
records.en_original: Um... I wanted to apologize to you two.
records.en_auxiliary: Um, I wanted to apologize to you two.
records.en: Um... I thought I needed to apologize to both of you.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 一体何のことでしょう？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean?
records.en: What are you referring to?

records.jp: ごめんなさい。　実は最初の時に出してもらった予算表、<CR>あれで問題なかったの
records.en_original: I'm sorry. To be honest, the first budget sheet you submitted didn't have any issues.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry. To be honest, the first budget sheet you submitted didn't have any issues.
records.en: I'm sorry. The first budget sheet you submitted<CR>was actually fine as it was.

records.jp: 私達の学年が予算オーバーしてて。<CR>その分を削らなきゃいけなかったんだけど、手詰まりで……
records.en_original: Our class had gone over our budget. We should have cut things from ours, but we couldn't agree on anything...
records.en_auxiliary: Our class had gone over our budget. We should have cut things from ours, but we couldn't agree on anything.
records.en: Our grade was over budget.<CR>We needed to cut that amount, but we'd reached an impasse...

records.jp: だから、他の学年と合わせて調整しようとしたんだけど、<CR>２年生もギリギリで、それであなたたちにあんなことを……
records.en_original: We decided to use what the other classes didn't, but when the second years barely made budget...it fell onto you.
records.en_auxiliary: We decided to use what the other classes didn't, but when the second years barely made budget... It fell onto you.
records.en: So we tried to adjust it together with the other grades,<CR>but the second-years were at their limit, and we did that to you...

records.jp: 本当にごめんなさい
records.en_original: I'm really sorry.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm really sorry.
records.en: I'm really sorry.

records.jp: ……正直に言って頂けて嬉しいです。<CR>黙っていればわからなかったのに
records.en_original: ...Thank you for being so open and honest with us. We never would have known if you stayed silent.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you for being so open and honest with us. We never would have known if you stayed silent.
records.en: ...I'm glad you told us honestly.<CR>We never would have known if you'd kept quiet.

records.jp: 白井さんがうちの実行委員に質問に来たでしょ？<CR>それでその子が気付いて……
records.en_original: Shirai came and questioned one of our class's committee members, right? I'm sure she must have realized...
records.en_auxiliary: Shirai came and questioned one of our class's committee members, right? I'm sure she must have realized...
records.en: Shirai-san came to ask one of our committee members questions, right?<CR>That made her realize...

records.jp: そうなんですね……
records.en_original: You heard about that, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: You heard about that, huh?
records.en: I see...

records.jp: それに……多分蜷川さん達も気付いてたんでしょう？
records.en_original: And... I'm sure you were actually aware of what was going on, too.
records.en_auxiliary: And I'm sure you were actually aware of what was going on, too.
records.en: And... You and the others had probably figured it out too, hadn't you, Ninagawa-san?

records.jp: ……そうですね。一応は
records.en_original: ...That's right. To an extent.
records.en_auxiliary: I had some ideas. To an extent.
records.en: ...Yes. More or less.

records.jp: でも、その事は何も言わずに予算を収めてくれて。<CR>お店まで教えてくれて、おかげで私たちも予算を収められた
records.en_original: But you said nothing and reduced your budget. Your advice allowed us to reduce ours, too.
records.en_auxiliary: But you said nothing and reduced your budget. Your advice allowed us to reduce ours, too.
records.en: But you kept quiet, brought your budget within the limit,<CR>and even told us about the stores, so we could do the same.

records.jp: だから、謝罪もだけど、改めてお礼を言いたかったの
records.en_original: So not only do I want to apologize, but I also want to thank you.
records.en_auxiliary: So not only do I want to apologize, but I also want to thank you.
records.en: So I wanted not only to apologize, but to thank you again.

records.jp: いえ、そんな。３年生には３年生の立場があるでしょうし
records.en_original: No, that's not necessary. Third year students have a standing to maintain.
records.en_auxiliary: No, that's not necessary. Third year students have a standing to maintain.
records.en: No, not at all. The third-years have their own circumstances.

records.jp: 蜷川さん……ありがとう
records.en_original: Ninagawa... Thank you.
records.en_auxiliary: Ninagawa, thank you.
records.en: Ninagawa-san... Thank you.

records.jp: 麻央、やっぱりみんなのこと考えてるんだね
records.en_original: Mao, you really do think about what's best for everyone.
records.en_auxiliary: Mao, you really do think about what's best for everyone.
records.en: Mao, you really were thinking about everyone.

records.jp: これで３年生は全員、私の味方になったわね
records.en_original: This made all of the third year students my allies.
records.en_auxiliary: This made all of the third year students my allies.
records.en: Now all of the third-years are on my side.

records.en_original: ...Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: ...Huh?

records.jp: 言ったでしょ？　後々の利に繋がるって。<CR>ただ攻めるだけが戦略じゃないのよ
records.en_original: I told you before. This will lead to future benefits. Attacking isn't the only strategy in the book.
records.en_auxiliary: I told you before. This will lead to future benefits. Attacking isn't the only strategy in the book.
records.en: I told you, didn't I? This will benefit me later.<CR>Attacking isn't the only strategy.

records.jp: う、うん……
records.en_original: O-Okay...
records.en_auxiliary: O-okay.
records.en: O-Okay...

records.jp: まさか向こうから謝ってくるとは思わなかったけど
records.en_original: I didn't think they would outright apologize, though.
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't think they would outright apologize, though.
records.en: Though I didn't expect them to come and apologize.

records.jp: ……蜷川さん
records.en_original: ...Ninagawa.
records.en_auxiliary: Ninagawa...
records.en: ...Ninagawa-san.

records.jp: 副会長。まだ何か？
records.en_original: Vice President. Is there something else?
records.en_auxiliary: Vice President. Is there something else?
records.en: Vice President. Is there something else?

records.jp: ……蜷川さん。<CR>実行委員の子に予算の事を指摘させたの、あなたでしょ
records.en_original: ...Ninagawa. You're the one who told the festival committee about the budget, aren't you?
records.en_auxiliary: Ninagawa, you're the one who told the festival committee about the budget, aren't you?
records.en: ...Ninagawa-san.<CR>You made that committee member point out the budget issue, didn't you?

records.en_auxiliary: Hmm?
records.en: ...What?

records.jp: 白井さんを利用して、こそこそ嗅ぎまわって
records.en_original: You used Shirai to sniff around in secret.
records.en_auxiliary: You used Shirai to sniff around in secret.
records.en: You used Shirai-san to snoop around in secret.

records.jp: すみません、何の事だか
records.en_original: I'm sorry, what are you talking about?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry... What are you talking about?
records.en: I'm sorry, but I don't know what you mean.

records.jp: しらばっくれないで！<CR>あなた、私たちの弱みを握ろうとしてたんでしょう！！
records.en_original: Don't play dumb! You were trying to find a weakness that you could use against us!
records.en_auxiliary: Don't play dumb! You were trying to find a weakness that you could use against us!
records.en: Don't play dumb!<CR>You were trying to get hold of something you could use against us!

records.jp: 副会長、落ち着いて下さい
records.en_original: Vice President, please calm down.
records.en_auxiliary: Vice President, please calm down.
records.en: Vice President, please calm down.

records.jp: そうやって色んな子の弱みを握って、脅して、<CR>自分のいいようにコントロールしようとしてるんだ！
records.en_original: You hold people's weaknesses against them, threaten them, and control them however you see fit!
records.en_auxiliary: You use people's weaknesses against them, threaten them, and manipulate them however you want!
records.en: You find people's weaknesses, threaten them,<CR>and control them however you want!

records.jp: (どうして……私以外にも麻央の裏側を知っている人がいたの？)
records.en_original: (What...? Are there other people who know Mao's hidden side?)
records.en_auxiliary: (What? Are there other people who know Mao's hidden side?)
records.en: (Why...? Was there someone besides me who knew Mao's true side?)

records.jp: ……白井
records.en_original: ...Shirai.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Shirai?
records.en: ...Shirai.

records.jp: え！？　私、誰にも言ってないよ！？
records.en_original: Huh!? I-I didn't tell anyone!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?! I-I didn't tell anyone!
records.en: Huh!? I didn't tell anyone!

records.jp: 知ってるわよ。<CR>副会長をなだめてあげて
records.en_original: I know. Go calm down the vice president.
records.en_auxiliary: I know. Go calm down the vice president.
records.en: I know.<CR>Go calm down the vice president.

records.en_original: ...Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: What?
records.en: ...What?

records.jp: 副会長は私が気に入らないようだから
records.en_original: It seems she doesn't care much for me.
records.en_auxiliary: It seems she doesn't care much for me.
records.en: She seems to dislike me.

records.jp: そんなに綺麗で頭が良くて、何でも持ってるのに！<CR>私みたいな人間、なんとも思ってないんでしょう！
records.en_original: You're pretty, and smart, and have everything! You probably don't think anything of people like me!
records.en_auxiliary: You're pretty, and smart, and have everything! You probably don't think anything of people like me!
records.en: You're beautiful and smart and have everything!<CR>You don't care at all about someone like me, do you!?

records.jp: あなたのせいで……私は……
records.en_original: Because of you... I...
records.en_auxiliary: Because of you, I...
records.en: Because of you... I...

records.jp: ……それじゃ
records.en_original: ...Good luck.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Good luck.
records.en: ...I'm leaving.

records.jp: ちょっと、麻央！！
records.en_original: Wait, Mao!!
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, Mao!
records.en: Wait, Mao!

records.jp: (ええ……どうしたらいいの……)
records.en_original: (Um... What should I do...?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Um, what should I do?)
records.en: (What am I supposed to do...?)

records.jp: 副会長、一体どうしたんですか？
records.en_original: Vice President, what happened?
records.en_auxiliary: Vice President, what happened?
records.en: Vice President, what happened?

records.jp: うっ……うっ……ぐすっ……
records.en_original: *sob*... *sob*... *sniffle*...
records.en_auxiliary: *Sob* *Sob* *Sniffle*
records.en: *Sob*... *Sob*... *Sniffle*...
